Walls: outer solid, party hatched, inner grey; concrete black. Furniture (built-ins, tables and beds) cut at 1.1 m: below solid, above dashed;
cupboard leaves dotted. Windows: id, sill/head in m. Dimensions in m. Rooms: area inside the walls.
